conventions.note: The ministry residential requirements set minimum net room areas and cap ground-floor coverage as a share of the plot; typical sales quotes are built-up (gross) area. Not confirmed in a clause. Net share is our own estimate.

research.note: The ministry guide delegates clear room height, riser, tread, exits and accessibility to SBC 201 and SBC 1101-1102 (paid, no free full text found). The guide itself states: internal passages in dwellings at least 0.90 m; minimum rooms (net): living/dining 11.2 m2 with 2.8 m width, bedroom 6.5 m2 with 2.1 m width, kitchen 5 m2 with 1.8 m width; villas capped at 14 m height. Those are not in the key list, so not stored.
